paragraphs: We are a global energy infrastructure company founded to help address energy poverty and accelerate the world's transition to reliable, affordable and clean energy. We own and operate natural gas and liquefied natural gas ("LNG") infrastructure, and an integrated fleet of ships and logistics assets to rapidly deliver turnkey energy solutions to global markets. Collectively, our assets and operations reinforce global energy security, enable economic growth, enhance environmental stewardship and transform local industries and communities around the world.
We deliver targeted energy solutions by employing an integrated LNG supply and delivery model:

LNG and Natural Gas Supply and Liquefaction – We supply LNG and natural gas regasified from LNG to our own power plants and to our customers. Our first floating liquefaction unit, which we refer to as "FLNG 1", began producing LNG in July 2024, and we source a significant portion of our LNG needs from this facility. Currently, demand for LNG above FLNG 1's capacity is acquired from third party suppliers in open market purchases. Starting in 2027, we expect to meet this demand under long-term supply contracts, which are based on an index such as Henry Hub plus a fixed fee component.

Shipping – We lease, own or operate a fleet of two floating storage and regasification units ("FSRUs") and seven liquefied natural gas carriers ("LNGCs") and floating storage units ("FSUs"). Six vessels are owned by Energos Infrastructure ("Energos"). We also charter vessels to and from third parties as well as from Energos.

Facilities – Through our network of current and planned downstream facilities and logistics assets, we are strategically positioned to deliver gas and power solutions to our customers seeking either to transition from environmentally dirtier distillate fuels such as automotive diesel oil ("ADO") and heavy fuel oil ("HFO") or to purchase natural gas to meet their current fuel needs.

As an integrated gas-to-power energy infrastructure company, our business model spans the entire production and delivery chain from natural gas procurement and liquefaction to shipping, logistics, facilities and conversion or development of natural gas-fired power generation. We currently conduct our downstream terminal operations at the following facilities:
•our landed micro-fuel handling facility in San Juan, Puerto Rico (the "San Juan Facility"), and
•our LNG receiving facility (the "La Paz Facility") and gas-fired power plant (the "La Paz Power Plant") at the Port of Pichilingue in Baja California Sur, Mexico.

In addition, we are currently developing facilities in Nicaragua and Ireland, as described below in more detail. We are in active discussions with additional customers to develop projects in multiple regions around the world who may have significant demand for additional power, LNG and natural gas, although there can be no assurance that these discussions will result in additional contracts or that we will be able to achieve our target pricing or margins.

On May 14, 2025, we completed the sale of our Jamaica business, including operations at the LNG import terminal in Montego Bay, the offshore floating storage and regasification terminal in Old Harbour and the 150 MW Combined Heat and Power Plant in Clarendon, along with the associated infrastructure (the "Jamaica Business"). We received cash proceeds of approximately $678.5 million, with an additional $98.6 million of proceeds held in escrow to be returned to us based on the terms of the sale agreement. The proceeds were partially used to repay all outstanding South Power Bonds of $227.2 million and certain transaction costs.

On April 1, 2026, we completed the Turbine Sale-Leaseback Transaction (as defined herein) with respect to certain turbines located in Puerto Rico for a purchase price of $265.9 million. The net proceeds from the Turbine Sale-Leaseback Transaction were used to repay certain indebtedness, thereby reducing our leverage profile.

We build facilities in locations where the need for natural gas is significant. We design and construct natural gas and power facilities to meet the supply and demand specifications of our current and potential future customers in an applicable region. In these markets, we first seek to identify and establish "beachhead" target markets for the sale of LNG, natural gas or natural gas-fired power, and we then seek to supply natural gas or power under long-term downstream contracts. Finally, our goal is to expand within the market and supply natural gas or power to additional industrial and transportation customers.

Our facilities position us to acquire and supply LNG to customers and natural gas-fired power in a number of attractive markets around the world. Downstream, we have seven facilities that are either operational or under active development. We currently have two operational LNG terminal facilities and two under active development, as well as one operational

power plant facility and two power plant facilities under active development, as described below. Our LNG facilities currently operating or under development are expected to be capable of receiving up to approximately 435,000 MMBtu from LNG per day depending upon the needs of our customers and potential demand in the region.

paragraphs: Restructuring Support Agreement and Restructuring Transaction

On March 17, 2026, NFE entered into the RSA with the Supporting Creditors. Under the RSA, the Supporting Creditors agree to support the Restructuring Transaction, which involves a comprehensive restructuring of the Company's principal funded debt obligations. For further discussion on the RSA, the Restructuring Plans and the Restructuring Transaction, see "Items 1 and 2. Business and Properties—Planned Debt Restructuring."
Restatement of Previously Issued Financial Statements

As previously reported on the Company's Current Report on Form 8-K filed on March 17, 2026, during the preparation of the Company's consolidated financial statements for the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company identified errors in its historical consolidated statements of cash flows and determined that adjustments are required to previously issued audited consolidated financial statements. Accordingly, the Company is restating its previously issued audited consolidated financial statements for the years ended December 31, 2024 and December 31, 2023. During the periods covered by the financial statements, the Company delayed payments to certain vendors on certain significant development projects, which allowed the Company to improve its working capital and liquidity. Payments for capital expenditures significantly outside of a vendor's customary payment terms should be classified as financing activities, as opposed to investing activities, which is how these payments were presented in the previously issued financial statements. In connection with the restatement, the Company is also correcting unrelated errors identified in prior periods. Additionally, the Company's unaudited consolidated financial statements as of and for each of the interim periods ended March 31, 2024, June 30, 2024, September 30, 2024, March 31, 2025, June 30, 2025, and September 30, 2025 are being restated to correct the classification of capital expenditures paid outside of customary payment terms, as well as to correct other unrelated errors. Refer to Note 1 and Note 33 of our notes to the consolidated financial statements included in this Annual Report for further discussion.

paragraphs: 本公司為一全球能源基礎建設公司，成立宗旨為協助解決能源貧窮問題，並加速世界向可靠、經濟且清潔的能源轉型。本公司擁有並營運天然氣與液化天然氣（"LNG"）基礎建設，並擁有整合型船隊與物流資產，以快速提供完整的能源解決方案至全球市場。整體而言，本公司資產與營運活動強化全球能源安全，促進經濟成長，提升環境管理，並轉型全球各地的產業與社區。
本公司透過採用整合型LNG供應與配送模式，提供針對性的能源解決方案：

LNG與天然氣供應與液化 – 本公司供應LNG與天然氣，經LNG重新氣化後，供本公司自有的發電廠與客戶使用。本公司第一座浮動液化單元，我們稱為"FLNG 1"，於2024年7月開始生產LNG，且我們從此設施取得相當大比例的LNG需求。目前，超過FLNG 1容量的LNG需求，係透過第三方供應商在公開市場購入。自2027年起，我們預期透過長期供應契約來滿足此需求，這些契約基於指數如亨利中心（Henry Hub）加上固定費用零組件。
運輸 – 本公司租賃、擁有或營運兩座浮動儲存與再氣化單元（"FSRUs"）與七艘液化天然氣載運船（"LNGCs"）與浮動儲存單元（"FSUs"）。六艘船隻由Energos Infrastructure（"Energos"）擁有。我們亦租賃船隻至第三方及Energos。
設施 – 透過我們現有與計畫中的下游設施與物流資產網路，我們具備戰略優勢，可提供氣體與電力解決方案至尋求轉型自較污染的柴油油（"ADO"）與重質燃油（"HFO"）或購買天然氣以滿足現有燃料需求的客戶。
作為一間整合型氣體至電力能源基礎建設公司，本公司業務模式涵蓋從天然氣採購與液化至運輸、物流、設施與天然氣發電轉換或開發的整個生產與配送鏈。本公司目前於以下設施進行下游終端營運：
• 我們位於波多黎各聖胡安的上岸微燃料處理設施（"San Juan Facility"），以及
• 我們位於墨西哥下加利福尼亞南岸皮奇林根港的LNG接收設施（"La Paz Facility"）與天然氣發電廠（"La Paz Power Plant"）。
此外，我們目前正在尼加拉瓜與愛爾蘭開發設施，如後文所述更詳細說明。我們正與更多客戶進行積極討論，以在世界各地多個地區開發專案，這些客戶可能對額外的電力、液化天然氣（LNG）及天然氣有顯著需求，不過無法保證這些討論會導致額外的契約，或我們能達成目標的價格或毛利率。

於 2025 年 5 月 14 日，本公司完成出售位於牙買加的業務，包括蒙特哥灣 LNG 進口碼頭的營運、舊港的離岸浮存儲與再氣化碼頭，以及克萊倫登的 150 MW 熱電聯產廠，以及相關基礎建設（以下稱「牙買加業務」）。本公司收到現金約 678.5 百萬美元，另計有 98.6 百萬美元的款項存放於託管帳戶，將根據買賣協議的條款歸還本公司。所得資金部分用以償還所有未償還的南電債券 227.2 百萬美元及部分交易費用。
2026年4月1日，我們完成有關位於波多黎各的某些渦輪機的渦輪機買斷租賃交易（如 herein 所定義），買價為265.9 百萬美元。來自渦輪機買斷租賃交易的淨所得用於償還某些債務，從而降低我們的槓桿率。
我們在天然氣需求顯著的地區建設設施。我們設計與建設天然氣及電力設施，以符合我們現有及潛在未來客戶在適用地區的供應與需求規格。在這些市場中，我們首先尋求識別並建立"進口點"目標市場，以銷售液化天然氣（LNG）、天然氣或天然氣發動電力，然後尋求在長期下游契約下供應天然氣或電力。最後，我們的目標是在市場內擴張，並向更多工業與運輸客戶供應天然氣或電力。

我們的設施使我們能取得並供應液化天然氣（LNG）給客戶，以及在世界各地多個有吸引力的市場中供應天然氣發動電力。下游，我們有七座設施，已經運營或正在積極開發中。我們目前有兩座運營中的LNG碼頭設施與兩座正在積極開發中，以及一座運營中的電力發電廠設施與兩座電力發電廠設施正在積極開發中，如後文所述。我們目前運營或正在開發的LNG設施預計將能接收每日常規約435,000 MMBtu的LNG，視客戶需求及該地區潛在需求而定。

paragraphs: 重整支持協議及重整交易
於 2026 年 3 月 17 日，NFE 與支持債權人簽訂了 RSA。根據 RSA，支持債權人同意支持重整交易，該交易涉及對本公司主要資金債務義務進行全面重整。有關 RSA、重整計畫及重整交易的進一步討論，請參閱「項目 1 與 2. 經營業務與財產—計畫中的債務重整。」
先前發行財務報表的重述

如本公司於 2026 年 3 月 17 日提交的 Current Report on Form 8-K 所 previously reported，於準備本公司 2025 年 12 月 31 日結止之合併財務報表時，本公司發現其歷史合併現金流量表中存在錯誤，並確認需對先前發行之審計合併財務報表進行調整。因此，本公司將重述其 2024 年 12 月 31 日及 2023 年 12 月 31 日結止之先前發行審計合併財務報表。在財務報表所涵蓋期間內，本公司延後支付某些供應商在某些重大開發專案的款項，這使本公司得以改善其營運資金與流動性。大幅超出供應商慣常付款條件的資本支出款項，應歸類為融資活動，而非投資活動，這也是這些款項在先前發行財務報表中所呈現的方式。配合重述，本公司亦正在修正先前期間中發現的無關錯誤。此外，本公司 2024 年 3 月 31 日、2024 年 6 月 30 日、2024 年 9 月 30 日、2025 年 3 月 31 日、2025 年 6 月 30 日及 2025 年 9 月 30 日結止之未審合併財務報表亦將進行重述，以修正超出慣常付款條件之資本支出款項的歸類，以及修正其他無關錯誤。有關進一步討論，請參閱本年度報告所附合併財務報表附註之附註 1 與附註 33。
